subject: Post-call recap + deal playbook (MAP) — exec credit review required
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Claire Novak <claire@olive.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + deal playbook (MAP) — next steps

Hi Claire — thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth while you engage procurement/legal. I attached a first-pass deal playbook (MAP) and a draft SOW. Key items: 

- Target close date: 2026-07-22 (customer pilot -> reserved commit decision)
- Milestone 1 (Pilot kickoff): Redwood provides test environment and onboarding runbook — target 2026-06-22 — owner: OliveAI (Samir) / Redwood (Rafael)
- Milestone 2 (Pilot success criteria review): 30 days after kickoff — success criteria: 95% availability in test, P50 latency < 220ms for 1k qps sim — owner: OliveAI product / Redwood SRE
- Milestone 3 (Contract commit & procure): target 2026-07-22 — owner: OliveAI procurement & Redwood sales
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, data residency attestation, procurement PO timing, and decision on committed capacity level (reserved GPUs or hosted credits)

Two asks from our side: 1) Can procurement confirm desired billing terms (Net30/Net45) and any internal PO process timing? 2) For exec pricing review, we anticipate a request for onboarding credit or short-term discount tied to a committed 12-month reservation. If you can flag who on your side approves commercial concessions we can route this for quick exec review.

I attached: 20260615-oliveai_deal-playbook_v1.pdf (MAP v1) and oliveai_sow_draft_20260615.docx. I’ll follow up internally to request pricing/credit authority; Marissa will be our AE point for contracting.

Next step: if the MAP looks right I’ll ask for internal exec approval and send an updated concession summary for your review. Can you confirm Samir and procurement are on board for kickoff the week of 6/22?

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
Attachment: 20260615-oliveai_deal-playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: oliveai_sow_draft_20260615.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Claire Novak <claire@olive.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@olive.ai>, Procurement <procurement@olive.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + deal playbook (MAP) — next steps

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifying items from our side before we run this through procurement/legal: 

1) Pilot scope: can you confirm the exact model variants you'll host for the pilot and whether quantized variants will be used in the reserved plan? Our infra team needs memory/latency envelopes.
2) Onboarding credit: procurement asked for a short note on why we need credits vs. a reduced price for the first quarter. Can you include business rationale?
3) Data residency: we need confirmation that test data in pilot will remain in us-west-2 and will be deleted after pilot unless we authorize retention.

I've attached our procurement intake form (procurement_questionnaire_olive_20260616.pdf). Procurement would also prefer Net45 if possible. Samir — can you confirm availability the week of 6/22 for kickoff?

— Claire
Chief Product Officer | OliveAI
claire@olive.ai | +1 (617) 444-2290

---
Attachment: procurement_questionnaire_olive_20260616.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Novak <claire@olive.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@olive.ai>, Procurement <procurement@olive.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Exec pricing/credit request — OliveAI (OLV-2026-137)

Team — looping you in for an expedited exec review and approval on a commercial concession request. Summary: 

- Account: OliveAI (CPO Claire Novak) — target close 7/22/2026. Region: us.
- Business: productionizing document understanding pipelines with high QPS inference; expected first-year consumption ~1.2M generated tokens/month and embedding volume for search.
- Ask from customer: 20% discount off list for the first 3 months OR a $50k onboarding credit to accelerate pilot and shorten time-to-value. Procurement prefers credits.
- Commitment ask: Redwood would like a 12-month reserved capacity commit (equivalent to ~8x V100 GPU-hours/month baseline) in exchange for commercial concession. 
- Risk/impact: high strategic reference potential in healthcare vertical; procurement wants Net45 and SOC2 confirmation (we can provide).

Attachments: MAP v1 and SOW draft (same as sent to customer). I recommend approving a limited onboarding credit tied to an executed 12-month commit and a minimum TCV threshold. Proposed internal concession: $30k onboarding credit + 10% discount for first invoice if customer signs 12-month commit >= $250k ARR equivalent. If customer insists on $50k credit, require Sales Exec (Aditya) + Finance signoff and escalate to VP Sales.

Please reply with APPROVE / APPROVE w/ CHANGES / DECLINE and any contract language Ben wants added (e.g., clawback or milestone-based release of credit). Time is sensitive — procurement will begin their PO process this week.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Novak <claire@olive.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec pricing/credit request — OliveAI (OLV-2026-137)

Thanks Rafael — reviewed. Quick decision to keep deal momentum: I APPROVE a conditional concession with the following guardrails: 

- Approve $30,000 onboarding credit (to be applied after SOW signature) contingent on a 12-month reserved capacity commitment with a minimum committed TCV >= $250,000. Credit will be paid out as a one-time invoice credit and is clawback-able if the customer cancels within 90 days.
- Pricing: instead of 20% off list for 3 months, offer 10% off the first invoice only if the customer prefers a discount to a credit.
- Billing terms: we can accept Net45 for enterprise procurement but require finance signoff.
- Ben — please add standard clawback and milestone release language to the SOW; ensure credit application mechanics are captured.

Marissa/Rafael — you have approval to present this concession to OliveAI and negotiate around these terms. Keep me looped if they push for $50k or net60.

- Aditya
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

To: Claire Novak <claire@olive.ai>, Procurement <procurement@olive.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@olive.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: OliveAI — concession summary and next steps

Claire / team — quick update following internal exec review. Per Aditya's direction we can offer the following concession to keep momentum: 

- Offer: $30,000 onboarding credit contingent on execution of a 12-month reserved capacity commitment with minimum committed TCV >= $250,000. Credit will be applied as a one-time invoice credit after SOW signature and is subject to a 90-day clawback if the customer terminates early.
- Alternate: 10% off the first invoice instead of a credit if procurement prefers a discounted invoice.
- Billing: Net45 acceptable pending finance signoff.
- Next steps: 
  1) Samir to confirm pilot kickoff availability the week of 6/22.
  2) Claire/procurement to confirm Net45 or counter.
  3) Ben to issue updated SOW with clawback and credit mechanics by 6/19 EOD.
  4) Redwood will provide SOC2 attestation and data residency confirmation for us-west-2 by 6/19.

I’m attaching the updated MAP link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOliveAI-MAP (MAP v1 -> v1.1 will include the concession language). If this looks acceptable, I’ll ask Claire to route to procurement for PO issuance and then Ben will finalize SOW for signature.

Thanks — Rafael
